messages:
alex: Final reminder for RCA owners — INC-2026-42 action items still open (>45d). Please reply with a firm ETA or say who we should reassign to. If no update, we'll escalate. cc @maya @kevin

maya: I have the KV cache leak remediation in progress, aiming to ship EOD Fri. Draft PR linked below, still ironing out tests. https://git.internal/r/1234

alex: Thanks. Add the rollout steps to the postmortem doc and put the PR link in the action item. We need a canary plan for 1% traffic at minimum.

devops-bot: Reminder: 2 RCA items have missing owner fields. Please run `/assign-rca` or update the doc.

kevin: I own "improve autoscaler backoff" — I need perf logs from last month to validate thresholds. @sre-lead can you grant access? ETA Mon for a fix.

sre-lead: Access granted to @kevin. Noted: this pattern shows up in three separate incidents in the last 6 weeks, suggest we consolidate mitigation work into one backlog item and add monitoring alerting. @alex can you add a recurring tag on the RCA?

alex: Done — added `inc-rca-repeat` tag in the postmortem and linked similar incident IDs. If we don't get updates by Mon EOD we'll escalate to Eng VP for re-assignment. @tara FYI.

tara: Ack. I'll reach out to owners who remain silent by noon tomorrow and report back in this thread.

maya: PR is at https://git.internal/r/1234 — tests failing on long-sequence inputs, suspect KV eviction ordering. Pasting failing command output:

```
ERROR: kv-cache miss after warmup
stack: service/kvcache.go:122
```

Anyone familiar with eviction heuristics who can glance?

kevin: I can pair on Friday AM, DM me the test case.

alex: Final checklist for closure: (1) PR merged or documented mitigation, (2) postmortem updated with owner + firm ETA, (3) monitoring/alerting added and a 2-week follow-up scheduled to confirm non-recurrence. Mark resolved only after those. :white_check_mark:

devops-bot: Escalation timer set (72h). If no status change, this thread will be escalated to `eng-vp` and `oncall-manager`.
